articles.title: BIS releases national testing standard for electric agricultural tractors
articles.summary: India has released national test standards for electric agricultural tractors, developed by the Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) for the first time. This ensures the safety, reliability, and performance of such machinery. The initiative aims to boost electric vehicle adoption in agriculture, providing farmers with dependable technology and promoting quality manufacturing, crucial for sustainable development and national progress.

articles.title: Mumbai’s vertical boom runs ahead of infrastructure
articles.summary: Mumbai's skyline is rapidly expanding with numerous high-rise constructions. However, critics argue this development lacks adequate urban planning and essential regulatory checks. This unchecked growth is reportedly undermining the city's overall coherence, functionality, and basic liveability for its residents. The concerns focus on sustainable urbanisation practices amidst rapid vertical expansion in India's financial capital.

articles.title: ISRO aims to commission third launch pad at Shriharikota in 4 years: Scientist
articles.summary: ISRO is developing a third launch pad at its Shriharikota spaceport. A top scientist confirmed that the Indian space agency is currently in the process of identifying suitable vendors for its construction. This expansion aims to enhance India's space launch capabilities and frequency, supporting future missions like Gaganyaan and increased commercial launches from the strategic facility.
